svg.title: Event-Contract Trading and Listing Gates
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-event-contract-trading-and-listing-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Event-Contract Trading and Listing Gates; subtitle: Four checks before a trade or a listing reaches a registered DCM; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Is the trade free of information from your job, your campaign or your employer?; pass next: G2; fail action: Kill the trade; a signed confidentiality agreement turns it into misappropriation and the CFTC will come after you.; gate: G2; question: Is the position free of any public misstatement meant to move price?; pass next: G3; fail action: Stop; pushing misstatements is market manipulation with or without insider-trading liability.; gate: G3; question: For a mention contract, are potential controllers and known insiders identified, with position limits, accountability, reporting and surveillance calibrated to them?; pass next: G4; fail action: Hold the listing until the insider map and surveillance calibration are done.; gate: G4; question: Do the terms of any geopolitical contract expressly carve out war pathways?; pass next: List on a registered DCM operating under its 23 core principles.; fail action: Redraft; under the proposal a facially neutral 'facility remains functional' contract involves war unless carved out.; caption: Insider trading and manipulation rules apply to prediction markets; a teleprompter operator's roughly 50 mention-market trades drew a $65,000 penalty after the up-to-25% cooperation discount.; assumptions note: Gate order is a synthesis of separate practitioner guidance; jurisdiction remains contested as Nevada and Massachusetts sue directly in state court.; note: Attributed to NEXTPredict (uh3GgMs9ha8, Miller), Profeissor.com Digital Assets, AI & FinTech (YIkTrxNRVlc, 4Vqws7tSo8E, G-sfCPFFZ5o) and A Lawyer In Finance Explains (MHeX-gRNpCE).

rect.title: gate: G1; question: Is the trade free of information from your job, your campaign or your employer?; pass next: G2; fail action: Kill the trade; a signed confidentiality agreement turns it into misappropriation and the CFTC will come after you.

gate: G2; question: Is the position free of any public misstatement meant to move price?; pass next: G3; fail action: Stop; pushing misstatements is market manipulation with or without insider-trading liability.

gate: G3; question: For a mention contract, are potential controllers and known insiders identified, with position limits, accountability, reporting and surveillance calibrated to them?; pass next: G4; fail action: Hold the listing until the insider map and surveillance calibration are done.

gate: G4; question: Do the terms of any geopolitical contract expressly carve out war pathways?; pass next: List on a registered DCM operating under its 23 core principles.; fail action: Redraft; under the proposal a facially neutral 'facility remains functional' contract involves war unless carved out.

text.title: Assumptions: Gate order is a synthesis of separate practitioner guidance; jurisdiction remains contested as Nevada and Massachusetts sue directly in state court.
